title: Initiative checkpoint taxonomy and cadence automation for SLO stewardship
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We lack a compact, machine-readable set of checkpoints for reliability initiatives that ties SLO health, incident history, and remediation windows into a single cadence. This makes it hard to automate rollouts, gate risky releases, or reallocate error budget across teams. Goal: Define a lightweight 'checkpoint taxonomy' (signal levels and required artifacts) and implement a weekly automation that produces per-initiative health beacons consumed by Console dashboards and a Slack digest. Outcomes: clearer go/no-go signals for canaries, automated nudges for initiative owners when SLI drift exceeds threshold, and faster triage of incidents back to initiative backlog items.
acceptance_criteria: Define checkpoint taxonomy with 4 canonical signals: Green/Monitoring/Degraded/Critical and associated mandatory artifacts for each signal
A Confluence spec published describing the field schema (checkpoint_type, timestamp, sla_window, cause_hint, attached_incident_ids)
Weekly automation job runs and writes checkpoint rows to the SLO-reconciler table and exposes JSON payload for Console ingest
Console dashboard shows initiative-level health beacon with drill-down to incidents and suggested remediation playbook
Slack digest posted to #reliability-weekly with highlights and owners assigned for red/yellow beacons
tasks: Finalize taxonomy draft with Reliability and Observability leads
Prototype Redis-backed checkpoint queue + serverless worker to reconcile into data warehouse
Schema review and approval by Data Infra (DDL + retention policy)
Console integration: consume JSON beacon, render timeline and badge
Build Slack digest template and sig-alert thresholds for auto-mentions
Write runbook for initiative owners describing required artifacts per checkpoint level
recent_updates: 2025-03-02: Kickoff with Reliability and Observability. Agreed on need for 4 signal levels and mandatory incident linkage.
2025-03-04: Design reviewed initial JSON schema; Data Infra requested TTL on checkpoint rows (90 days) to control storage costs.
2025-03-07: Trade-off discussion: adding per-initiative gross error-budget vs using SLO percentage. Decided to surface both, but primary beacon uses SLO percentage for simplicity.
2025-03-09: Prototype worker (serverless) posts sample JSON beacons to staging data warehouse. Console team validated ingest contract; minor field rename (cause_hint -> root_cause_hint) approved.
2025-03-10: Security review requested due to incident IDs in payloads; SecOps asked for PII scrub checklist and KMS key usage for the warehouse write path.
